safeguarded_relaxation_trajectory.cause_of_stage_2_inactivity: Symmetric difference |Delta A_k| decreased monotonically from 130 at Outer 50 down to 4 at Outer 100, but never reached the required threshold |Delta A_k| <= 2 for 3 consecutive iterations. Consequently, the driver remained strictly in Stage 1 (omega_d = 0.50) throughout all 100 iterations.

r6_vs_r7_comparative_synthesis.r6_vs_r7_identity: Because the Stage 2 activation criterion (|Delta A_k| <= 2 for 3 iterations) was never triggered, Package 171-R7 executed identically to Package 171-R6 under pure omega_d = 0.50 damping, producing the exact bitwise and numerical terminal state (delta_d = 8.3084e-3, delta_u = 5.6421e-5 mm, delta_H = 378.74 MPa, active_count = 160). This conclusively confirms that the active-set stabilization gate |Delta A| <= 2 was overly restrictive under uniform damping omega_d = 0.50 within a 100-iteration budget.

first_numerically_meaningful_failure_mec: STAGE_2_NEVER_ACTIVATED: Membership stability criterion (|Delta A_k| <= 2 for 3 consecutive iterations) was never met because the active set continued shedding nodes at 4-12 nodes/iteration down to Outer 100 (reaching |Delta A| = 4 at iteration 100). As a result, candidate relaxation omega_d = 0.85 never engaged, leaving the solver in the slow uniform-damping contraction regime (rho ~ 0.989) which stalled at the 160-node crack-tip plateau and exhausted the 100-iteration budget.
